categories.title: Required
categories.desc: Skyrim Together and what it needs. Every player must have these.

categories.title: Stability
categories.desc: Crash and bug fixes. They only affect your own PC, so friends don't strictly have to match — but they should.

categories.title: Recommended
categories.desc: Quality-of-life improvements that work well in co-op.

categories.title: Visuals
categories.desc: Graphics mods generally work fine with Skyrim Together.

categories.title: More content
categories.desc: Adds items to the world. Every player must install the same ones in the same order.

mods.name: Skyrim Script Extender (SKSE64)
mods.desc: Lets other mods add features to the game. Must match your exact game version.

mods.name: Address Library for SKSE Plugins
mods.desc: Lets SKSE mods work across game versions. Use the 'All in One' file.

mods.name: Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch
mods.desc: Fixes thousands of quest and game bugs. Needs the 4 free Creation Club files.

mods.name: SSE Engine Fixes
mods.desc: Fixes engine crashes and memory problems. The Skyrim Together team confirms Engine Fixes 7 loads with 1.8.

mods.name: Bug Fixes SSE
mods.desc: Fixes small engine bugs that cause odd behavior.

mods.name: SSE Display Tweaks
mods.desc: Borderless and frame-rate fixes, plus a physics fix for high refresh rate monitors.

mods.name: SkyUI
mods.desc: Much better inventory, favorites and the Mod Configuration Menu.

mods.name: Skyrim Souls RE - Updated
mods.desc: Menus don't pause the game — makes sense in multiplayer, where the world keeps going anyway.

mods.name: A Quality World Map
mods.desc: Readable world map with roads — easier to plan where the group goes.

mods.name: Better Dialogue Controls
mods.desc: Fixes mouse selection in dialogue menus.

mods.name: Better MessageBox Controls
mods.desc: Keyboard and mouse fixes for pop-up boxes.

mods.name: Static Mesh Improvement Mod (SMIM)
mods.desc: Better-looking objects all over the world.

mods.name: Realistic Water Two
mods.desc: Nicer water. Has a plugin, so everyone should install it.

mods.name: Enhanced Lights and FX
mods.desc: More atmospheric interior lighting. Has a plugin, so everyone should install it.

mods.name: Immersive Weapons
mods.desc: Hundreds of new weapons in loot and shops. Used on community co-op servers.

mods.name: Immersive Armors
mods.desc: Lots of new armor sets in loot and shops. Used on community co-op servers.

compatLabels.safe: Known to work with Skyrim Together
compatLabels.likely: Reported to work — test before a long session
